C_TFC_PROTOCOL_EXTRACTION.natural_statement: From any feasible initial full schedule and each root-reachable literal center-and-promotion process, construct the normalized priorities, actual center, common-cutoff separators, attained cutoffs and earliest-advance traces needed by the raw-history theorem, for every nonempty gap; assemble the resulting marks and gaps into a covering terminating bounded-description hierarchy. No list, boundary, compression or construction-existence conclusion is assumed.

C_TFC_HISTORY.natural_statement: All root-reachable construction histories at arbitrary depth, including repeated changes of frame, preserve I1-I3 and the global node and split description bounds without assuming those conclusions.
